clauses.text: Keep this file current in the same PR.
A merge never cuts a tag. `/release` does.
Branch from `main` and open a PR into `main`.
Delete merged feature branches locally and remotely.
Never claim a result you did not observe
clauses.rationale: Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing.

clauses.text: Change only selected managed configuration; preserve unrelated files, local overrides, credentials and application state.
clauses.rationale: The one rule. It is the reason this skill exists rather than a prompt; lose the line and the skill becomes a generic assistant with extra steps.

clauses.text: never ask about anything in it
clauses.rationale: Inspection answers detectable facts; ask only for missing intent or conflict decisions.
